facts.fact: The Director of the Institut National de la Statistique launched the renovated web portal of the Plateforme Nationale d'Information pour la Nutrition (PNIN), housed at the INS, described as an interactive digital library giving access to the reports, studies, surveys and analysis briefs produced by the PNIN and its partners, for decision makers, researchers, media and the public.
